testing.value: Sampled settlements have coverage confirmation, authorised approver and release on file; 0 incomplete files.

checklist.step: Maintain an audit trail of settlement and payment
checklist.value: ClaimCenter and the payment system record approval, payee and value date for each settlement.

testing.value: For sampled claims, authorised settlement amounts trace to executed payments; 0 unmatched or over-authority payments.

checklist.step: Screen claimants and payees against OFAC lists before disbursement
checklist.value: Every run-off settlement payee is screened against current OFAC lists before funds are released.

testing.value: 100% of settlement payments have a clear OFAC screening result on file with no unresolved hits; blocked/rejected as required and reported.

answers.value: In-force policies from the terminated binder to be moved to a direct or alternative arrangement: the population continuing on cover that must be transferred to another carrier, MGA or direct handling before or at expiry.
The transition window from binder cessation until the last policy is moved or expires (respecting policyholder notice periods, e.g. 60-90 days per policy): 2026-09-30 onward through the run-off.

Each transition record shows policy, policyholder, new arrangement, effective transfer date and continuity-of-cover confirmation; a record missing the destination or transfer date is held until confirmed.
The count of policies transitioned plus those expired reconciles to the in-force population at cessation; no policy is left without a destination (unassigned count must reach 0).
Transition instructions, policyholder notices and confirmations filed in OpenText /run-off/transition/ with timestamp and version; retained 7 years.

A policy that cannot be placed with an alternative arrangement is logged as an exception in Archer with disposition (non-renew with notice / run to expiry / direct handling), owner = Delegated Authority Manager, reviewed monthly.
Each transition decision (destination and basis per policy cohort) is documented in the Archer run-off register with the Portfolio UW Manager and Delegated Authority Manager sign-off.
Policyholders, producers, the receiving carrier/MGA and finance are notified of the transfer; recipient list captured on the transition record with required policyholder notices logged.
The full in-force population at cessation (census), each policy tracked to a confirmed destination or expiry.
PASS = every in-force policy has a confirmed destination with continuity of cover and required notices served; FAIL = any policy left unassigned, a coverage gap, or a missing policyholder notice.
On FAIL, assign the policy to run-to-expiry or direct handling, serve the required notice, log in Archer, and escalate coverage-gap risk to the Portfolio UW Manager and Delegated Authority Manager.

Acceptance criteria: every in-force policy transitioned or scheduled to expiry with no coverage gap, required policyholder notices served, and NPI transferred only under the DA agreement and privacy terms.
Evidence in OpenText /run-off/transition/ (transition register, notices, receiving-carrier confirmations) and the Archer run-off register entry.

checklist.step: Document each policy transition and continuity of cover
checklist.value: Transition register records destination, effective date and continuity confirmation for every in-force policy, filed in the versioned folder.

testing.value: Every in-force policy has a confirmed destination or expiry with no coverage gap; 0 unassigned policies.

checklist.step: Serve required policyholder non-renewal/transfer notices
checklist.value: State-required non-renewal or transfer notices served within the mandated period before the change takes effect.

testing.value: Days between notice and effective date meet the state minimum for every affected policy; 0 short-notice transfers.

checklist.step: Confirm screening before cover is bound on the alternative arrangement
checklist.value: Insureds moving to a new bound arrangement are screened per policy before binding on the receiving carrier/MGA.

testing.value: Sampled transitioned policies show screening completed before the new cover was bound; 0 unscreened binds.

checklist.step: Limit redisclosure and reuse of policyholder NPI in the transfer
checklist.value: Policyholder nonpublic personal information is transferred to the receiving arrangement only as permitted, under the DA agreement and GLBA redisclosure limits, with no reuse beyond servicing the transferred policies.

testing.value: Sampled transfers show NPI shared only with the authorised receiving party under a data-handling agreement; 0 unauthorised redisclosures.
